question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Statinary** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is '**stationary**', which means not moving or still. (हिल नहीं रहा है या स्थिर ) • The incorrect spelling '**statinary**' is a common mistake due to the similarity in pronunciation. • The correct spelling can be remembered by associating it with the word 'stationery', which refers to writing materials. (लेखन सामग्री) • The root word '**station**' in both 'stationary' and 'stationery' can help in remembering the correct spelling. Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Entrance **refers to a place where one enters or exits a building or area. (वह स्थान जहाँ कोई किसी भवन या क्षेत्र में प्रवेश करता है या बाहर निकलता है) • **Brief **means short or concise. (संक्षिप्त ) • **Thunder **refers to the loud sound that accompanies lightning during a thunderstorm. (आंधी के दौरान बिजली गिरने के साथ होने वाली तेज़ आवाज़) 3b:T688, The correct answer is: "**His simple request was denied by authorities.**"
